title: Assitant loan manager
description:
**Job Responsibilities:**

* Assist customers with loan applications and documentation.
* Explain loan products, eligibility criteria, and interest rates.
* Verify customer documents and maintain accurate records.
* Coordinate with banks and financial institutions for loan processing.
* Follow up with customers regarding loan approvals and disbursements.
* Handle customer queries and provide timely support.
* Maintain daily sales and loan application reports.

**Required Skills:**

* Good communication and convincing skills.
* Basic knowledge of loans and banking processes.
* Good computer and MS Excel knowledge.
* Customer handling and follow-up skills.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person
